consequence.statement: Memory panels in the Grafana dashboard now display memory units. There is no operational consequence for an operator.

original.statement: The Grafana dashboard now shows memory units on panels that display memory usage; this is a cosmetic bugfix.

decision.reason: [ev-e730a0f53228] lists this under Bug fixes as a Grafana dashboard fix that adds memory units to panels showing memory usage. That is a display-only change to dashboard panels. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated, and no running behaviour an operator relies on changes. "none" (informational, low severity) fits better than behavior-change.
